pattern.description: The cursor travels down the 'Fields in this view' list (Summary, Goal, Impact), each row lighting up with action icons, and resting on Impact pops a description card beside the panel.
pattern.why_premium: Real hover affordances (row icons, explanatory card) explain field meaning in-product, with no added callouts; the motion lands just before the narration's 'Now you can remove existing fields'.

build_hint.gsap: Recorded UI. To recreate: tl.to('.cursor', {y: 90, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power1.inOut'}); per-row hover via tl.set('.field-row.is-hover', ...) as the cursor crosses rows; tl.set('.row-actions', {autoAlpha: 1}); tl.fromTo('.field-card', {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.12, ease: 'power2.out'}, '+=0.2').
build_hint.remotion: Cursor y = interpolate(frame, [0, 9], [startY, endY], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad)}); hovered row index from cursor y; card opacity = interpolate(frame, [24, 28], [0, 1], {extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}).

notes: Hover states are discrete UI state changes; the description card appears within about two frames, so fade vs instant is unclear.
